nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet and Tailwind v4 @theme configuration: defines the SN Pro font stack, brand accent, semantic action/status color tokens with paired on-* foreground tokens, and per-theme [data-theme] overrides powering the app's light/dark and multi-theme system.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses paired --color-<x> / --color-on-<x> tokens so a solid fill and its foreground text always travel together, preventing the light-text-on-light-fill bug class across themes.
